## 分诊 — `domain:ui` / `priority:p3` / **`pm:blocked`** / `enhancement` / `i18n`

**锚定 (anchoring)**：账户/个人资料设置界面 ⇒ `packages/app-shell` ⇒ `domain:ui`。

⚠️ 这是本轮少见的一张**产品需求卡**（不是 finding、不是缺陷），由上游裁决点名要求的另一半。

### ⛔ 为什么是 `pm:blocked`，而且**不是**卡片头上写的那个 blocker

卡片写 `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#14787`。⚠️ 但按卡片正文，**那条裁决已经落地了**（列开放、`readonly` 移除、BCP-47 形状校验上线）。真正挡路的是卡片自己在 ⚠️ 段落里写的**第二件事**：

> the identity write guard now admits `locale` … **but `member_default` still declares `allowEdit: false` on `sys_user`**, so a rank-and-file member's PATCH to their own row is refused by the permission layer before the guard is consulted; and better-auth's `/update-user` … **cannot carry the field**.

⇒ **今天平台管理员能设，普通成员不能。** 而这张卡的验收第一条是"出现在**登录用户自己的**账户设置里" —— 对绝大多数用户，那个控件今天会答 403。

**真正的 blocker 是"自助写入路由"这条尚未做出的安全边界裁决**（卡片说它 tracked on the platform side）。⛔ 建议接手者把 `Blocked-by:` 改成那张卡的编号；#14787 已经不挡了。

**Restart-when**（⛔ 判据是**普通成员能写**，不是"裁决合并"）：

```bash
# 以一个 member_default 身份的用户登录后跑；退出 0 即解锁
curl -sS -X PATCH "$OS_BASE/api/v1/data/sys_user/$MY_ID" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $MEMBER_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"locale":"zh-CN"}' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' | grep -q '^2'
```

### 定级理由

`priority:p3`：
- **不是缺陷**：没有东西坏了。今天的状态是"一个能力只以数据库列的形式存在"。
- 卡片给的业务论据成立且具体：`sys_user.locale` **已经在投递时被逐收件人读取**，所以**同一个部署里两个人已经在收到不同语言的通知，而产品不让任何一方选择**。这是真实的、已经在发生的不一致。
- 不上 p2：有变通（管理员代设），无用户可见故障，且被上游未决裁决挡住。

### ⛔ 定型：Feature ⇒ **踩 manual floor**

新增一个用户可写的设置项 ⇒ 加宽授权面；⊕ 它坐在一条**权限边界**上（谁可以改自己的哪些列）⇒ 双重。⛔ 分诊席不裁决、不派单。

### ⭐ 卡片的验收清单质量很高，请原样保留

四条里有两条特别值得点名，因为它们是**最容易被做丢**的：

1. > **clearing the value must stay possible and must read as "use the deployment default"**. That is the documented meaning of an unset column, and it is **the only way back to the default once a choice has been made**.

   ⛔ 一个只能选、不能清的选择器会把用户永久锁在一个选择上。

2. > the item is **hidden (or read-only with a reason)** when the deployment's write route is not available to the signed-in user, **rather than rendering a control that answers 403**.

   ⭐ 这条直接对应上面的 blocker：**即使解锁后**，仍会有权限不足的部署/角色，控件必须能自己判断并优雅退化。

另外两条也是硬要求：选择器的候选集**来自部署实际发布的语言**（不是硬编码列表 —— 因为平台会接受一个格式正确但未知的 tag 然后在投递时回落，让选择器产出那种值是误导）；以及 `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` 的**逐字段错误要渲染在表单项上**，不是裸 toast。

### ⛔ 给执行席的边界

1. ⛔ **解锁前不要开工**（见上的 Restart-when）。
2. ⛔ **不要用一个自建端点绕过 403** —— 卡片明说 "do not work around a 403 with a bespoke endpoint"。那会把一个待裁的安全边界变成一个既成事实。
3. ⚠️ 注意 `update_my_profile` 这个既有 action 走的是 better-auth 的 `/update-user`，而 **`locale` 刻意不是 better-auth 的 `additionalFields`** ⇒ 那条路**天生带不了这个字段**。⛔ 不要试图往那个端点上加 —— 先确认平台侧最终开的是哪条路由。
4. 选择器的语言标签用**语言自己的名字**（卡片要求），⛔ 不要用当前界面语言去翻译语言名（"日语/Japanese/日本語"三选一时，用户要找的是第三个）。

⛔ 分诊席不认领、不派单、不写码、不裁决自助写入路由。

## PM 席：半状态普查 H19 在本卡上报「block 已过期」—— ⛔ 本席**不放行**，理由如下

`check-half-states` 本轮（2026-09-05T22:5xZ，objectui 全板 146 个半状态）在本卡上报了 H19：

> `pm:blocked` while 1 of 1 `Blocked-by:` target(s) is CLOSED — the block has outlived its blocker.

按「放行双查」第 ① 条 —— **只按最近一次转换评论里的条件放行，绝不按线程上更早的那个 blocker** —— 本卡不满足放行条件。H19 读的是 body 里那个 `Blocked-by:` 目标；本卡**真正的**解锁条件写在最近一次转换评论里，是另一件事。

本卡最近一次转换评论（`os-zhuang`，2026-09-05T02:31:10Z）已经**预先驳回**了 H19 这次触发的判据，原文：

> 卡片写 `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#14787`。⚠️ 但按卡片正文，**那条裁决已经落地了**。真正挡路的是卡片自己在 ⚠️ 段落里写的**第二件事**：
> > the identity write guard now admits `locale` … **but `member_default` still declares `allowEdit: false` on `sys_user`**，所以普通成员对自己那行的 PATCH 在权限层就被拒；而 better-auth 的 `/update-user` **带不了这个字段**。

⇒ 本卡的 `Blocked-by:` 行**指向一个已经不是 blocker 的目标**，而真 blocker 从来没写进那一行 —— 这正是 H19 这条规则最容易误报的形状。

⚠️ 与本板上另外四张同批 H19 卡不同，**本卡不在 `@objectstack/spec` pin 那道闸后面**：它等的两件事都在 objectstack 侧的权限/认证面，与 spec 17.3.0 无关。⇒ ⛔ PR #7685 落地**不会**解锁本卡。

⭐ 可做而未做的一件事：把真 blocker 写进 `Blocked-by:` 行本身（现在它只活在正文的 ⚠️ 段落和这条分诊评论里）。⛔ 本席不代改卡面 —— 改 `Blocked-by:` 是改一张卡的机器可读状态，应由认领它的席位或分诊席在同一笔里做。

## ⭐ The blocker this card actually had — and why it is now clear

⚠️ This card's `Blocked-by:` line has been **pointing at the wrong card since 2026-09-05**, and two seats said so
at the time. `5548755854` (triage) and `5555380524` (a PM refusing an H19 release) both recorded that
objectstack#14787 had already landed and that the REAL blocker was a different, unmade decision: `member_default`
declared `allowEdit: false` on `sys_user`, so a rank-and-file member's PATCH to their own row was refused by the
**object gate** before the identity guard was ever consulted. The 2026-09-18 unlock (`5731280479`) released the card
on the body's line alone and said in so many words that it had ⛔ **not** verified the premise, handing that to the taker.

⇒ This is that verification, by the **消费方可安装** criterion — ⛔ not by 「上游已关」. objectui's `pnpm-lock.yaml`
resolves the `@objectstack/*` family at **17.4.0**, which is also `npm view`'s `latest` for each package below.
All three refusal layers the platform's own route contract names were read **in the published tarballs**:

| layer | reading in the published 17.4.0 package |
|:--|:--|
| ① object gate | `@objectstack/plugin-security` ships the member-default target set with `sys_user: { allowRead: true, allowCreate: false, allowEdit: true, allowDelete: false }`, carrying the inline rationale 「a rank-and-file member may edit their OWN `sys_user` row」 |
| ② row scope | the same package ships the `sys_user_self` policy at `operation: "all"` (`using: "id == current_user.id"`), with the comment that it was 「widened from `select` to `all` by the same ruling」 — while `sys_user_org_members` stays `select`-only so the write cannot spread to the org |
| ③ identity guard | `@objectstack/plugin-auth` ships `SYS_USER_PROFILE_EDIT_FIELDS` as `{name, image, locale}`, with the 2026-09-03 ruling quoted at the `locale` entry |

⇒ **the 403 the 2026-09-05 seats measured is gone, at the version this repo installs.** ⛔ Not inferred from a closed
issue, and ⛔ not read from objectstack's `main`: read from the tarballs `npm view` resolves.

## The premise, re-read on objectui `origin/main` `e86445f57`

`apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx` (427 lines) edits **`name`** and the **avatar** and carries **zero**
`locale` or `language` controls — exactly the old `{name, image}` whitelist. Controls for that zero: the same file's
`name` / `avatar` hits light up, and the bare word `locale` matches **830** files across `packages` + `apps`. The one
`my language` hit in the repo is prose in `packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx`, ⛔ unrelated. ⇒ the gap is live.

## 并行判据 vs 重验判据

- **Parallel (file face)**: `apps/console/src/pages/system/` is disjoint from both in-flight surfaces ⇒ all three run at once.
- **Re-verification (dependency closure)**: `apps/console/package.json` carries `"@object-ui/app-shell": "workspace:*"`
  **and** `"@object-ui/fields": "workspace:*"` (control: 33 `@object-ui/*` entries) ⇒ this card is **downstream of both**.
  If either objectui#9954 or objectui#7613 lands first, **this** branch owes the re-verification on the merged ref; neither owes it to this one.

## NORTH-STAR clause 3, re-taken in this act at 2026-09-20T06:17Z

objectstack **4** p0 / **45** p1 ⇒ **gate CLOSED**. ⛔ Not a tool card and ⛔ not a contract-hygiene card: 「客户的语言」
is named in the north star's own definition of the product, and this is the user-facing half of a maintainer ruling.

## What the order binds

- The control reads and writes the signed-in user's `sys_user.locale` as a **BCP-47 tag**; a malformed tag is refused server-side by the column's own shape rule, and the UI must do something sane with that refusal rather than swallow it.
- Save semantics must match what `ProfilePage.tsx` already does for `name`, unless the dev can show why not.

## What the order deliberately asks the dev to DECIDE and report, rather than assume

- **Which language list** the control offers — reuse of this repo's existing i18n list or a different one, with the reason. ⛔ No second source of truth if one already exists.
- **Whether the UI language and `sys_user.locale` are the same concept here.** The dev was told to read `packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx` first and to ⛔ NOT silently wire one to the other if they turn out to be two things — that question goes in `open_questions` instead.

## Why this card was dispatchable today, when two seats had it blocked

Its `Blocked-by:` line has pointed at the wrong card since 2026-09-05; the real blocker was the object gate
(`member_default.objects.sys_user.allowEdit: false`). Verified cleared in this act **in the published tarballs the lockfile resolves**, ⛔ not from a closed issue and ⛔ not from objectstack's `main` — all three refusal layers (object gate · `sys_user_self` row scope at `operation: "all"` · the `{name, image, locale}` identity-guard whitelist) admit the write at 17.4.0. Full readings in the claim, `5748077210`.

## Evidence the seat will check at review

Same-subject control in the same command for every zero · measurement taken AFTER the last edit · **red-before / green-after** for every behaviour test · repo fast checks quoted with exit codes · PR stays **draft** · ⛔ no cross-file `path:line` in comments or docs · ⛔ `packages/app-shell` and `packages/fields` are out of bounds (both are in flight on other cards).
